content.short: Rubic is a cross-chain technology aggregator enabling seamless asset swaps across 70+ blockchains with a white-label SDK for dApp integration.
content.description: Rubic is a comprehensive cross-chain aggregation protocol enabling users to swap tokens across more than 70 blockchains in a single transaction, aggregating routes from dozens of bridges and DEXes to deliver optimal cross-chain execution. For dApp developers, Rubic provides a white-label widget and SDK to embed cross-chain swap functionality directly into their products without building bridge infrastructure. Mantle is fully supported within the Rubic ecosystem for cross-chain asset movement.
content.meta: Rubic is a cross-chain tech aggregator enabling swaps across 70+ blockchains including Mantle. Discover Rubic on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
